info.title: API.SH: Zenodo
info.description: The Zenodo API from API.SH: public Zenodo data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

Text formats come back in `citation`, JSON formats in `data`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zenodo-cite

get.description:
Searches Zenodo's open research records (datasets, software, papers, preprints, posters, images...) with every filter the site offers. Each record has title, DOI and concept DOI, creators with affiliations and ORCID, description, keywords, subjects, license, resource type, access right, version, grants, related identifiers, communities, view and download counts and its files (name, size, checksum, link). A record holding more than 100 files comes back with `files_omitted: true` and without its file list, file totals and view and download counts (open it with /zenodo/v1/record for those). The answer also carries facet counts (resource types, access status, subjects, file types, years). Searches page through the first 10,000 results. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zenodo-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words; Zenodo's query syntax works too (e.g. `title:"sea level"`, `creators.name:Smith`).

get.description:
Autocomplete and lists for Zenodo's controlled vocabularies: subjects (MeSH, GEMET, FOS...), funders, affiliations, licenses, resource types and languages. Use the ids as filter values on the search routes. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zenodo-vocabulary

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to match (without it, the vocabulary is listed in its own order).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
